name: Sofiya Petrovna Volkova
source: Like her twin sister, Sofiya is friendly and vivacious, but unlike Natalya is much more level-headed and grounded in reality. Despite being the younger twin, she's the one responsible for keeping watch over her ditzy sister, which often proves harder than it might look at first glance. Beautiful, intelligent, and a supreme cook to top all that, she strives to be the perfect sister for Natalya to look up to.
